title: Fix with regression test: lost update between concurrent stop and message writes
taskPrompt:
# Your Assignment: Fix: a stop request is silently lost when it races a message write

## Ticket
ID: BATT-106
Description: When a user hits stop while a message write is in flight, the stop flag sometimes vanishes and the run keeps going. bug-report.md describes two captured occurrences; store.ts is the state store module. Find the root cause — this is a concurrency defect, not an input-validation one — make the smallest correct fix, and add a regression test that simulates the interleaving. Delegate the code work to claude_code.
